title: The remaining path is a suffix of the input path
statement: Let $\ell$ be a list of free literals of a clause, each paired with its position index, and let $p$ be a decision-tree path, that is, a list of variable–direction pairs; let $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$ be restrictions on $n$ variables. Then the remaining path returned by processing $\ell$ against $p$ (starting from $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$) is exactly the suffix of $p$ obtained by deleting its first $\min(|\ell|,\,|p|)$ entries.
hypotheses_covered: ρ₀, σ: restrictions on n variables
replaced:
The remaining path returned by $\mathrm{processClauseLits}$ equals
$\mathrm{path}.\mathrm{drop}(\min(\mathrm{lits.length}, \mathrm{path.length}))$.
